uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-tool-status.text: Connected "shop::Order" to "Line Item". Edit the selected relation in Properties.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Relation — shop::Order → Line Item":
  - heading "Relation — shop::Order → Line Item" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Generalization"
    - option "Realization"
    - option "Composition" [selected]
    - option "Aggregation"
    - option "Association"
    - option "Bidirectional"
    - option "Plain Assoc."
    - option "Dependency"
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "Line Item"
    - option "shop::Order" [selected]
  - text: Target endpoint
  - combobox "Target endpoint":
    - option "Line Item" [selected]
    - option "shop::Order"
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label"
  - text: Source multiplicity / cardinality
  - textbox "Source multiplicity / cardinality"
  - text: Target multiplicity / cardinality
  - textbox "Target multiplicity / cardinality"
  - text: Source navigability
  - combobox "Source navigability":
    - option "Unspecified" [selected]
    - option "Navigable"
    - option "Non-navigable"
  - text: Target navigability
  - combobox "Target navigability":
    - option "Unspecified" [selected]
    - option "Navigable"
    - option "Non-navigable"

  - paragraph: Drag a line segment to reroute, or press Delete to remove this relation.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
